title: CycloneDX Hardware Model
$comment: OWASP CycloneDX is an Ecma International standard (ECMA-424) developed in collaboration between the OWASP Foundation and Ecma Technical Committee 54 (TC54). The standard is published under a royalty-free patent policy. This JSON schema is the reference implementation and is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Hierarchical classification of a physical item. The `category` and `subcategory` form a free-text hierarchy; the `codes` array carries scheme-bound classification codes drawn from external taxonomies.

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: More specific classification within the category, such as `microcontroller`, `voltage-regulator`, or `ceramic-resonator`.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: Scheme-bound classification codes from external taxonomies.

taxonomyCode.title: Taxonomy Code
taxonomyCode.description: A classification code assigned by an external taxonomy.

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: The taxonomy or coding standard that issued the code.

value.title: Value
value.description: The code value as defined by the standard.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of the code definition or the publishing authority.

boardLocation.title: Board Location
boardLocation.description: Placement of an item on a printed circuit board, panel, or assembly. A single item record may cover multiple physical placements when the items are functionally identical, in which case all reference designators are listed.

designators.title: Designators
designators.description: Reference designators identifying the placement on the assembly, such as U5, R12, C3.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Board layer on which the item is mounted.

meta:enum.inner: Embedded in an inner layer of a multi-layer board.

subsystem.title: Subsystem
subsystem.description: Functional subsystem on the board with which the item is associated.

deviceType.title: Device Type
deviceType.description: Package or mounting style of the physical item. Either a predefined device type or a custom device type.

preDefinedDeviceType.title: Predefined Device Type
preDefinedDeviceType.description: Package or mounting style of the physical item, drawn from the predefined set.

meta:enum.smd: Generic surface-mount device, package shape not otherwise specified.
meta:enum.pth: Plated through-hole, leaded part inserted into the board.
meta:enum.qfp: Quad flat package with leads, surface-mount.
meta:enum.to: Transistor outline package, through-hole or surface-mount variants.
meta:enum.discrete: Discrete component without a standardized integrated-circuit package.

customDeviceType.title: Custom Device Type
customDeviceType.description: A device type that is not present in the predefined set.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom device type.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the custom device type.

leadTime.title: Lead Time
leadTime.description: Supplier lead time for procuring the item.

value.title: Value
value.description: Typical lead time as a numeric value in the specified unit.

range.title: Range
range.description: Observed range of lead times, useful when supply is volatile.

observedDate.title: Observed Date
observedDate.description: Date on which the lead time was observed or quoted.
